```{r}
library(future.apply)

# Plan de parallélisation (multisession pour Windows)
nbCores <- parallel::detectCores() - 1
plan(multisession, workers = nbCores)

####################################
###### Fonction de simulation ######
####################################
simu_PELT <- function(n)
{
  # Constantes locales
  penalty <- 2.2 * log(n)
  gap <- 2
  # Changepoints relatifs
  chpts <- c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1) * n
  
  data <- dataGenerator_1D(
    chpts      = chpts,
    parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
    sdNoise    = 1.5
  )
  
  # Chrono avec pruning
  PELT <- system.time(pelt(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  # Chrono sans pruning (Rcpp)
  PELT_Rcpp <- system.time(pelt_rcpp(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  list(n = length(data), PELT = PELT, PELT_Rcpp = PELT_Rcpp)
}

simu_SVP <- function(n)
{
  # Constantes locales
  penalty <- 3
  gap <- 2
  # Changepoints relatifs
  chpts <- c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1) * n
  
  data <- dataGenerator_1D(
    chpts      = chpts,
    parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
    sdNoise    = 1.5
  )
  
  # Chrono avec pruning
  SVP <- system.time(SVP(data, penalty, "gaussian_mean"))[["elapsed"]]
  
  # Chrono sans pruning (Rcpp)
  PELT_Rcpp <- system.time(pelt_rcpp(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  list(n = length(data), SVP = SVP, PELT_Rcpp = PELT_Rcpp)
}

####################################
###### exécution en parallèle ######
####################################
# vecteur de tailles à tester
start <- 20000
end   <- 30000
my_n_vector <- round(10^(seq(log10(start), log10(end), length.out = 10)))

# nombre de répétitions par n
p <- 20

# lancer toutes les simulations
results <- future_lapply(my_n_vector, function(n) {
  replicate(p, simu_SVP(n), simplify = FALSE)
}, future.seed = TRUE)

# aplatir la liste
results_flat <- do.call(c, results)

##########################################
###### mise en data.frame final ##########
##########################################
df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_flat, as.data.frame))

head(df)

write.csv(df, "C:/Users/alexa/Desktop/2024-2025/LaMME/changepoints/simulations/timeSIGNAL.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
######################
###### packages ######
######################
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#####################################
###### lire et transformer df #######
#####################################
MyData <- read.csv("C:/Users/alexa/Desktop/2024-2025/LaMME/changepoints/simulations/timeSIGNAL.csv")

# Mise au format long (PELT vs PELT_Rcpp)
df <- MyData %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("SVP", "PELT_Rcpp"),
               names_to = "method",
               values_to = "time")

# Nettoyage : retirer NA, Inf, temps nuls ou négatifs
df <- df %>%
  filter(is.finite(time), time > 0)

############################################
###### résumé avec moyenne et quantiles ####
############################################
data_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(n, method) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
            q1 = quantile(time, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            q3 = quantile(time, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Limites pour l'axe Y (sécurisé)
theMin <- min(data_summary$q1[data_summary$q1 > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
theMax <- max(data_summary$q3[data_summary$q3 > 0], na.rm = TRUE)

##########################################
###### régressions log-log (scalabilité) #
##########################################
lm_results <- df %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  do(model = lm(log(time) ~ log(n), data = .))

################################
###### PLOT with ggplot2 #######
################################
ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = n, y = mean, col = method)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(theMin, theMax)) +
  labs(y = "time in seconds",
       x = "length of the time series",
       color = "Méthode",   # titre de la légende
       shape = "Méthode") +
  geom_point(size = 2, aes(shape = method)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3), width = .01) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("SVP" = "blue",   "PELT_Rcpp" = "red"),
                      labels = c("SVP" = paste("SVP slope :", round(coef(lm_results$model[[1]])[2], 2)),
                                 "PELT_Rcpp" = paste("PELT slope :", round(coef(lm_results$model[[2]])[2], 2)))) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("SVP" = 16,       "PELT_Rcpp" = 17),
                     labels = c("SVP" = paste("SVP slope :", round(coef(lm_results$model[[1]])[2], 2)),
                                "PELT_Rcpp" = paste("PELT slope :", round(coef(lm_results$model[[2]])[2], 2)))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = c(0,1),
        legend.justification = c(0,1),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("darkred", 0.2), colour = "NA"),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = alpha("black", 0.3)))

# Résumés des modèles
summaries <- lapply(lm_results$model, summary)

# Coefficients (intercept + pente log-log)
coeffs <- lapply(lm_results$model, coef)

print("=== Coefficients (intercept, slope) ===")
print(coeffs)

```
